summary: Typosquat of @solana/web3.js — bundled CommonJS/ESM contains child_process + curl + fetch keyword co-occurrence
details: Package published under the scope `@solana-labs` (note: the legitimate Solana JavaScript SDK is published as `@solana/web3.js` under the `@solana` scope, not `@solana-labs`). The bundled `lib/index.cjs.js` and `lib/index.esm.js` contain keyword co-occurrence of `require('child_process')`, `curl`, `ping`, `POST`, and `fetch(` within a minified rollup. Pattern matching alone cannot distinguish whether these are reachable at install/import time, default-parameter URLs, build-tooling spawn calls, or an actual exfil/dropper composition — the bundle needs human de-minification and trace to confirm. Combined with the suspicious scope-name divergence from the canonical Solana SDK, this warrants human review before any disposition is published.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
